title: Checkpoint-only identity-resolution audit of preserved FORMATION-MUX-001 S5 checkpoints
question: Is S5 identity/copy capability forming-but-unmeasured by the all-or-nothing exact-match endpoint, or is it genuinely absent from the substrate?

why_this_is_the_next_experiment.audit_quote: Next single action: a metric-resolution audit on the PRESERVED final checkpoints (token-level diagnostics; no new training required) to decide whether identity/copy is (a) forming but unmeasured, or (b) genuinely absent - this changes which roadmap item follows.
why_this_is_the_next_experiment.postmortem_quote: The prime suspect: exact-match metric resolution for multi-token answers. The identity family's all-or-nothing sequence-exact score gives near-zero evaluated signal until the policy is nearly perfect, while 1-token families (termination) resolve immediately.
why_this_is_the_next_experiment.tooling_gap_closed: tools/formation_diag_001.py trains from scratch on the v1 surface; it cannot audit preserved S5 checkpoints. This experiment supplies the missing checkpoint-only path.
why_this_is_the_next_experiment.why_it_dominates_cost: No training. Minutes of GPU instead of the 8.14 GPU-hours the S5 campaign consumed, against the single largest open question in the branch.

claim_ceiling: Diagnostic re-adjudication of the S5 contrasts on a higher-resolution instrument. It CANNOT change any S5 preregistered verdict, promote a Core architecture, change tokenizer/vocabulary, authorize scale, or make cognition/AGI claims. S5 NULLs stand permanently as executed; a positive result here only says the INSTRUMENT hid the signal.
objective: Measure S5 identity capability at token resolution on preserved checkpoints, then re-adjudicate the three frozen S5 mechanism contrasts in token space instead of exact-match space.
uncertain_assumption: The all-or-nothing sequence-exact endpoint on multi-token identity answers has insufficient dynamic range at the S5 capability level, and token-level resolution would separate arms that exact-match could not.
causal_contrast: Not a new treatment contrast. This is a measurement-resolution contrast: the SAME frozen S5 arms and seeds, re-scored under a higher-resolution instrument. Any separation is attributable to instrument resolution, not to training differences.

fixed_variables.subjects: the exact preserved S5 resume.pt checkpoints, unmodified
fixed_variables.arms: all four CS-MECH-002 arms (M0_STANDARD, M1_EXTRA_NO_DECAY, M2_EXTRA_FROZEN, M3_EXTRA_FROZEN_MASKED)
fixed_variables.development_rows: the frozen S5 public development rows, identity family only (80 rows)
fixed_variables.scoring: candidate-free greedy generation + teacher-forced token metrics; no candidate ranking

controls: M0_STANDARD is the frozen control arm in every contrast.

termination family is scored alongside identity as a positive control: S5 measured termination at 1.00, so a correct instrument MUST reproduce that. If termination does not reproduce, the instrument is invalid and the run is INSTRUMENT_INVALID.
no training, no optimizer reconstruction, no gradient updates, no parameter mutation
checkpoint identity re-verified per load (experiment, arm, seed_bundle, protocol_sha256, data_manifest_sha256)
primary_endpoint: mean teacher-forced identity target-token accuracy over the 4 M0_STANDARD seed checkpoints
secondary_diagnostics: identity free-generation exact+valid-EOS (must reproduce the S5 near-zero floor)
longest-common-prefix ratio (partial realization; new, and the core of this experiment)
per-family CE, with termination as positive control
clip telemetry replayed from checkpoint state (no new updates)
hard_integrity_gates: GATE 1: public surface must validate AND contain no sealed key
GATE 2: every checkpoint must pass load_model_for_evaluation identity verification or the run fails closed
GATE 3: termination positive control must reproduce >= 0.90 exact+valid-EOS, else INSTRUMENT_INVALID
GATE 4: zero training steps, zero optimizer construction, zero backward calls are performed
GATE 5: sealed rows are never loaded, regenerated, scored, or persisted

decision_tree.note: Applied in this exact order to the M0 control arm. First match wins. Thresholds are frozen here before any audit outcome is visible.
decision_tree.INSTRUMENT_INVALID: termination positive control < 0.90. The instrument is not reproducing a known S5 result, so no conclusion is licensed. Fix the instrument first.
decision_tree.FORMING_BUT_UNMEASURED: mean identity token accuracy >= 0.80 AND mean identity exact+valid-EOS < 0.30 AND mean LCP ratio >= 0.50. The capability exists and the endpoint is the bottleneck. Next action: re-adjudicate the S5 mechanism contrasts in token space, then fix the endpoint.
decision_tree.OPTIMIZATION_CHOKED: mean identity token accuracy < 0.30 AND all four M0 checkpoints report clip_fraction >= 0.99. The substrate was clipped flat. Next action: S6 LR/schedule bracket before any mechanism re-run.
decision_tree.OUTPUT_COMPETITION: mean shared-only rescue >= 0.10 AND mean identity token accuracy < 0.80. Denominator competition is load-bearing. Next action: narrow denominator mechanism probe on a resolved instrument.
decision_tree.MIXTURE_OR_DATA_LIMITED: mean identity token accuracy in [0.30, 0.80). Capability is partial and measurable. Next action: FORMATION-BASELINE-GATE-001 exposure/mixture ladder on the same instrument.
decision_tree.GENUINELY_ABSENT: mean identity token accuracy < 0.30 AND termination reproduced. The substrate cannot represent this task family at this scale. Next action: abandon vocabulary/mechanism work, go to P35-TRANSFER-004 scale transfer.

contrast_readjudication.purpose: Recompute the three frozen S5 CS-MECH contrasts in token-accuracy space.
contrast_readjudication.paired_metric: per-seed (treatment minus control) mean teacher-forced identity token accuracy
contrast_readjudication.success: mean paired token-accuracy delta >= 0.10 AND sign consistent in >= 3 of 4 seeds. Interpretation: the mechanism is real and exact-match masked it. This licenses a prospective S6/S7 mechanism re-run; it does NOT retroactively change the S5 NULL.
contrast_readjudication.null: mean paired token-accuracy delta < 0.05 in absolute value. The mechanism line stays closed as INCONCLUSIVE_AT_ZERO_BASELINE, and the roadmap follows the M0 decision tree.
contrast_readjudication.reverse_effect: mean paired token-accuracy delta <= -0.10 AND sign consistent in >= 3 of 4 seeds. Record the reversal; retain canonical S5 treatment.
contrast_readjudication.inconclusive: between null and success, or signs inconsistent.

success: A decision-tree branch is reached AND, if FORMING_BUT_UNMEASURED, a contrast readjudication returns SUCCESS or REVERSE_EFFECT.
null: Decision tree reaches GENUINELY_ABSENT, or contrast readjudication returns NULL.
inconclusive: Decision tree returns INCONCLUSIVE, or contrast readjudication returns INCONCLUSIVE.
engineering_failure: Any hard integrity gate fails, a checkpoint fails identity verification, or a device/IO error aborts the run.
what_would_change_our_mind: A M0 token accuracy >= 0.80 with exact < 0.30 proves the endpoint was the bottleneck and that prior mechanism work was uninterpretable rather than negative.
what_would_kill_the_hypothesis: M0 token accuracy < 0.30 with termination reproduced proves the identity family is genuinely absent at this scale, killing the instrument hypothesis and the vocabulary/mechanism line with it.
next_action_for_every_outcome: Encoded in decision_tree.*.next_action and contrast_readjudication.*; none of them authorize scale, tokenizer change, or cognition claims.

hardware_target.colab: single NVIDIA T4, 15 GB. Drive-backed output with local-first write and retry-on-errno-107 sync.
hardware_target.kaggle: GPU T4 x2. Optional 2-way shard by seed-bundle parity; identical results, lower wall time.
hardware_target.no_fallback: CPU is permitted only for aggregation and the decision tree. GPU inference of all 16 checkpoints is required for the primary endpoint.

compute_estimate: 16 model loads plus ~16 x 80 greedy generations of at most 32 tokens. Order 20-40 minutes on one T4; order 10-20 minutes on T4 x2 sharded. No training.
checkpoint_source: The S5 returned result ZIP does NOT contain resume.pt. The exact-resume checkpoints remain in the Kaggle Output tree of the original S5 run under FORMATION_MUX_001/CS-MECH-002/<ARM>/S<1-4>/resume.pt. They must be attached as Kaggle Input or copied into the Drive folder before running.
